title: Odd Weird Numbers
exact_target: Can an odd integer have more than itself as the sum of its proper divisors, while no subset of those divisors sums exactly to it?

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, \emph{UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems}, record 1500 (NUM-006). CC BY 4.0.
Wenjie Fang, \emph{Searching on the boundary of abundance for odd weird numbers}, arXiv:2207.12906 (2022), Section 1, abundance, semiperfectness and the odd-weird-number existence question.
